title: Project outstanding findings and supported dispositions
description:
Extend existing super-auto run records and scope-dispositions to retain source occurrences, explicit reference links, deferral and supported disposition. Project outstanding/deferred findings mechanically, retaining unsupported inputs. Helpers validate references/evidence fields; agent judges semantic support. No competing roast ledger or six-state lifecycle.
Spec: docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-16-workflow-reliability/2026-10-16-finding-continuity-design.md
Files: skills/super-auto/run-state.md, skills/super-auto/scripts/scope-dispositions, tests/super-auto/test-scripts.sh
owns: Validated outstanding-finding projection and durable disposition records.
consumes: Immutable invocation/artifact identities and complete source occurrence extraction.
Acceptance:
- [ ] Explicit references link occurrences; ambiguous matches stay separate.
- [ ] Supported resolution/rejection explicitly references findings and basis; assignment/success/silence do not resolve.
- [ ] Missing or unsupported external input leaves known evidence open.
- [ ] Key-only punch-list output contains outstanding deferred findings, including verified fixes supplied elsewhere.
- [ ] Projection/record validation fixtures pass; source identity and extraction consumed from predecessors (needs: super-plan-ufz.8.1, super-plan-ufz.8.2).
blocked-by super-plan-ufz.8.1: consumes immutable invocation/artifact identities
blocked-by super-plan-ufz.8.2: consumes complete source occurrence extraction

title: Carry findings through collection resume and reports
description:
Collect settled immutable review bundles into the committed run directory and recover interrupted collection. Route final-review items and punch lists through the validated outstanding projection. Latest review remains distinct from historical obligations.
Spec: docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-16-workflow-reliability/2026-10-16-finding-continuity-design.md
Files: skills/super-auto/SKILL.md, skills/super-auto/resume.md, skills/super-auto/report-prompt.md, skills/super-auto/scripts/report-status, skills/super-auto/run-state.md, tests/super-auto/test-scripts.sh
owns: Artifact collection/recovery and consistent outstanding findings in resume, Remaining and status.
consumes: Validated outstanding projection from predecessor.
Acceptance:
- [ ] Blocked review followed by ready/silent retry preserves prior actionable findings.
- [ ] Collection resumes idempotently before later invocation or cleanup; missing bundle is an evidence gap.
- [ ] Resume, Remaining and status use the same outstanding projection.
- [ ] Latest ready review cannot conceal earlier unresolved findings.
- [ ] Coordinator runs representative fresh-agent behavior evaluation; producer/consumer fixtures pass.
blocked-by super-plan-ufz.8.4: consumes Complete occurrence extraction and validated outstanding-finding projection.

title: Extract complete source finding occurrences
description:
Add a complete extraction mode to existing report-verdict, preserving source/section/occurrence identity and original text, including deferred items. Preserve default and --keys behavior. Caller supplies immutable source identity; this helper owns extraction, not storage or semantic disposition.
Spec: docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-16-workflow-reliability/2026-10-16-finding-continuity-design.md
Files: skills/super-code/scripts/report-verdict, tests/super-code/test-report-verdict.sh
owns: Complete source occurrence extraction contract.
consumes: Existing final-review/report formats and caller-supplied immutable source reference.
Acceptance:
- [ ] Complete additive extraction includes all relevant finding sections including deferred items and preserves occurrence/source references and original text.
- [ ] Existing default and --keys outputs retain their semantics.
- [ ] Repeated parsing of the same source retains stable occurrences; malformed/missing source is explicit, not an empty clean review.
- [ ] Focused extraction fixtures pass.

title: Preserve distinct invocation review artifacts
description:
Persist per-invocation identity separately from runTag; use it for single/cluster/seam/stub review artifacts and preserve reviewPath/null semantics in both execution paths.
Spec: docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-16-workflow-reliability/2026-10-16-finding-continuity-design.md
Files: skills/super-code/SKILL.md, skills/super-code/coordinator.js, skills/super-code/coordinator-workflow.md, skills/super-code/coordinator-subagents.md, skills/super-code/scripts/dispatch-text.mjs, tests/super-code/test-dispatch-text.sh, tests/super-code/replay-harness.mjs
owns: Invocation identity and immutable review artifact bundle.
consumes: Existing runTag and launch records.
Acceptance:
- [ ] Two invocations sharing runTag retain distinct artifact bundles including split reviews.
- [ ] Invocation identity is persisted before review creation and replayed on resume.
- [ ] reviewPath and null retain existing meanings; both execution paths pass focused fixtures.
